title: The Passion Balancer
opening: When willingness to continue falls, look for what changed before calling yourself lazy. Difficulty may have risen, value may be harder to see, or both may have shifted. The answer can still be uncertain.

labels.sourceBoundary: This short comparison does not explain every cause of changed willingness. Rest, health, conflict, missing resources, changed obligations, or other conditions may matter too. If the cause or value is unclear, gather relevant evidence before treating one explanation as settled.

cases.name: The route changed
cases.before: A volunteer repairs bicycles at a nearby room. People use the repaired bikes to get to work.
cases.after: The room moves across town; each visit now adds two hours of travel. The repairs still help people get to work.
cases.reading: The travel cost clearly rose while the useful outcome is still visible. Check whether a nearer room, shared delivery, or a shorter shift is actually possible. Continue only if an arrangement fits; changing or stopping can also be reasonable.

cases.name: The effect is unclear
cases.before: A trainer's monthly checklist helped a team catch missed handoffs.
cases.after: The team changed its process and no one has used the checklist for weeks. The trainer feels less interested.
cases.reading: Do not assume the value only became hidden. Ask whether the team still needs this check, whether the new process covers it, and what happens when it is absent. If the need remains, alter the tool; if it does not, stop maintaining it.

cases.name: Both may have shifted
cases.before: A neighborhood garden produced vegetables for a nearby pantry with a modest water bill.
cases.after: Water limits cut the harvest, and new rules make tending the beds harder. The pantry's need remains, but this garden may no longer meet it well.
cases.reading: Keep the two changes separate: the practical cost rose, and the useful result may have weakened. Check whether a lower-water plan would help the pantry. Do not count the need itself as proof that this particular arrangement works.
